_about: The Challenge Wheel presets (SPEC.md › PvP: the Challenge Wheel). Three named lists the GM can switch per run and edit mid-run from the console; the editor's JSON import/export uses exactly this shape: { presets: { id: { name, entries: [entry] } } }. Entry: id, name, hosted (played on the two phones) or not (run at the table / on Discord), game (hosted only: a purpose-built duel in packages/shared/challenge/hosted.js — quickdraw, speedmath, memorymatch, trivia, highestcard, typingrace, emojimemory — or one of the four Versus items clash, diceduel, shellgame, holdemduel, hosted by the items adapter), link (external only), rules (shown on both phones), capSeconds (null = balance challenge.hostedCapSeconds / externalCapSeconds at runtime), players ('1v1', or 'team': relay-able, played best-of-three), weight on the wheel, enabled.

entries.name: Clash (War)
entries.rules: One card each from a fresh deck, high card wins. Ties go to war: three down, one up.

entries.name: Dice Duel
entries.rules: Roll and stack. Stop when you like; bust past the threshold and you lose. Highest total standing wins.

entries.name: Shell Game
entries.rules: The defender hides the pea, the attacker picks a shell. Find it to win.

entries.name: Hold'em Duel
entries.rules: Heads-up hold'em, one hand, all-in. Best five cards win.

entries.name: Quick-Draw
entries.rules: Watch the TV. When it flashes, tap. First tap wins; tap early and you lose.

entries.name: Speed Math
entries.rules: Five sums. First to five right wins; most right when the clock runs out.

entries.name: Memory Match
entries.rules: Twelve cards, six pairs, taking turns. A match keeps your turn. Most pairs wins.

entries.name: Trivia
entries.rules: Five questions from the GM's bank. Most right wins; the faster player breaks a tie.

entries.name: Highest Card
entries.rules: One card each. Highest wins; ties redraw.

entries.name: Rock-Paper-Scissors (best of 5)
entries.rules: Best of five throws, on three. Tell the phones who won.

entries.name: Arm Wrestle
entries.rules: Elbows on the table, one pull. Back of the hand touches, you lose.

entries.name: Thumb War
entries.rules: One, two, three, four. Pin for a count of three.

entries.name: Staring Contest
entries.rules: No blinking, no talking, no faces. The table judges.

entries.name: Paper-Ball Free Throws
entries.rules: Three throws each into the bin from the agreed line. Most in wins; sudden death on a tie.

entries.name: Cup Stack Race
entries.rules: Stack and unstack the pyramid. First back to flat wins.

entries.name: One-Minute Drawing
entries.rules: The GM names a thing. One minute to draw it. The table votes the better one.

entries.name: Liar's Dice
entries.rules: Five dice each under the cup. Bid or call liar. First to lose all five dice loses.
